This fork is deliberately small. Upstream's panel had a sidebar, an AI summary,
an execution timeline, and a wide composer; this one is a conversation with one

likely to be declined — but say what you are trying to do and there may be a
smaller answer.
-->

## Would this change the panel's size or layout?

The panel lives in a browser side panel, so its width and height belong to the
